name: @merces/math
description: Merces mechanism math. Stage 1's reference math (@merces/reference, SPEC v1.1.2) is the implementation; this package re-exports it with the few helpers Stage 1 does not have, and a unit-scale and curve family ported from Stage 1's Rust (A-MATH-3). Since S4 also Stage 1's signing primitives (messages, secp256k1, domain, series key, keccak bid commitment), with the test-key derivation on the subpath `@merces/math/testing`.
